notes.note: Reviewed the telemetry-only delta in the cited source paths against this document. Runtime routing adds the authenticated tier-lowering feedback callback and reports the package version; lifecycle adds terminal notice output; config mutation can await the callback while retaining its existing file authority; other route, process, permission, storage and provider paths are unchanged. The document describes those unchanged owners or refers telemetry details to the updated usage-telemetry reference, so no prose change is needed. The focused eight-file route/service/CLI suite passed 460 tests; this review makes no new deployment or release claim. Follow-up live startup exposed a CLI readiness race: the CLI now decides which notices to print from pre-launch receipts and prints after readiness; the server records its own log notice asynchronously. The refined CLI boundary test failed before that repair and all 223 CLI lifecycle cases passed after it. Rechecked this delta against the cited claims.
